archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Metro Redux next-gen update arrives on Xbox Series X|S

entries.headline: Metro Redux next-gen update arrives on Xbox Series X|S with 4K/120fps support
entries.summary: 4A Games has released a free next-gen update for Metro 2033 Redux and Metro: Last Light Redux, adding native 4K/60fps and upscaled 4K/120fps modes alongside improvements to textures, lighting, animation and controller feedback.
entries.verification: The opened first-party developer article on Xbox Wire directly states that the update is live and lists its performance modes and improvements.
entries.timeNote: The Xbox Wire article was published at 00:30 on October 30, Beijing time; the update was already live.

mediaAlts.alt: Illustration accompanying this report: Metro Redux next-gen update arrives on Xbox Series X|S with 4K/120fps support

entries.headline: Once Human developers look back at the ocean design of Isles of Abyss
entries.summary: The Once Human team explains how the free Isles of Abyss expansion makes the ocean an active threat and extends modular construction to boats. An exclusive Xbox Game Pass Ultimate bundle is claimable until November 18.
entries.verification: The opened first-party developer article on Xbox Wire directly describes the expansion design and the bundle deadline.
entries.timeNote: The Xbox Wire article was published at 22:00 on October 29, Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Illustration accompanying this report: Once Human developers look back at the ocean design of Isles of Abyss

entries.headline: Crimson Desert DLC Charting the Unknown arrives on Xbox Series X|S
entries.summary: Crimson Desert DLC Charting the Unknown launched on October 29, adding new adventures on land and at sea. Xbox players can also try the base game free for five hours between October 29 and January 6, 2027.
entries.verification: The first-party Xbox Wire article directly provides the DLC launch, platform and free-trial arrangements.
entries.timeNote: The Xbox Wire article was published at 06:00 on October 30, Beijing time; the DLC launched on October 29 local time.

mediaAlts.alt: Illustration accompanying this report: Crimson Desert DLC Charting the Unknown arrives on Xbox Series X|S

entries.headline: Bay 12: Mech Repair announced for PC first in Q1 2028
entries.summary: Crimson Herring Studios has announced mech-maintenance simulator Bay 12: Mech Repair for Steam and GOG in Q1 2028. PS5, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch 2 versions are planned after the PC release.
entries.verification: Two independent outlets, AUTOMATON and Denfaminicogamer, report the October 29 announcement and mech-repair gameplay. The specific window and platforms follow the store information cited by AUTOMATON.
entries.timeNote: The earliest selected opened report was published at 06:16 on October 30, Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Illustration accompanying this report: Bay 12: Mech Repair announced for PC first in Q1 2028

entries.headline: The Duskbloods delayed to 2027 as FromSoftware refines rules and balance
entries.summary: FromSoftware has moved Nintendo Switch 2 multiplayer action game The Duskbloods from its 2026 release window to 2027, saying it will use the extra time to refine the game rules and balance.
entries.verification: Two independent outlets, Gematsu and Game Informer, relay FromSoftware's delay statement.
entries.timeNote: The earliest selected opened report was published at 22:06 on October 29, Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Illustration accompanying this report: The Duskbloods delayed to 2027 as FromSoftware refines rules and balance

entries.headline: Escape from Tarkov begins maintenance for update 1.3.0 as Unity 6 migration is deferred
entries.summary: Battlestate Games has begun installation maintenance for Escape from Tarkov update 1.3.0 and its Halloween event. The planned migration to Unity 6 has been deferred from this update; the current version remains based on Unity 2022.3.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report provides bounded information on maintenance, update 1.3.0 and the engine migration not taking place. No revised date beyond the report is asserted.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON article was published at 15:48 on October 29, Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Illustration accompanying this report: Escape from Tarkov update 1.3.0 goes live, while the Unity 6 migration is deferred

entries.headline: Dokapon Kingdom Connect 2 announced for summer 2027
entries.summary: Compile Heart has announced Dokapon Kingdom Connect 2, the series' first entirely new game in approximately 23 years. It adds battles in which all players cooperate against giant monsters and is planned for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch and PC.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays Compile Heart's official announcement on October 29.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON article was published at 11:00 on October 29, Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Illustration accompanying this report: Dokapon Kingdom Connect 2 announced for summer 2027

entries.headline: Apex Legends Cipher update arrives November 3 with dual-wield Wingman
entries.summary: The Apex Legends Cipher update launches on November 3, adding dual-wield Wingman and Legend-ban voting in ranked matches at Diamond and above.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report clearly specifies the update name, date and two gameplay changes.
entries.timeNote: The IGN article was published at 02:21 on October 30, Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Illustration accompanying this report: Apex Legends Cipher update arrives November 3 with dual-wield Wingman

entries.headline: Report: Gears of War: E-Day sold more than 400,000 copies in its first month
entries.summary: IGN relays an estimate from The Verge's sources that Gears of War: E-Day sold more than 400,000 copies across console and PC. Microsoft and the developers have not confirmed the figure, which excludes Game Pass access.
entries.verification: IGN cites sources at The Verge and estimates from an analytics firm. The sales figure remains an estimate without official confirmation.
entries.timeNote: The IGN article was published at 07:13 on October 30, Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Illustration accompanying this report: Report: Gears of War: E-Day sold more than 400,000 copies in its first month

entries.headline: Chaos Smash launches for PC browsers and DMM Games
entries.summary: Moon Rabbit launched free-to-play artillery combat game Chaos Smash on October 29 for PC browsers and DMM Games, with terrain destruction, player marriage and guild battles among its systems.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays Moon Rabbit's service-launch announcement.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON article was published at 16:41 on October 29, Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Illustration accompanying this report: Chaos Smash launches for PC browsers and DMM Games

entries.headline: END OF ETERNITY ENHANCED REMASTER launches on PS5 and Steam
entries.summary: tri-Ace launched END OF ETERNITY ENHANCED REMASTER on October 30: a standalone PS5 release and DLC for END OF ETERNITY 4K/HD EDITION on Steam. Features include native 4K, HDR, 120fps and a double-speed mode.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays tri-Ace's launch information, platforms and feature specifications.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON article was published at 09:14 on October 30, Beijing time, before this edition's 10:10 cutoff.

mediaAlts.alt: Illustration accompanying this report: END OF ETERNITY ENHANCED REMASTER launches on PS5 and Steam

entries.headline: Hunting Simulator 3 launches with hunting areas in Colorado and Texas
entries.summary: Nacon launched Hunting Simulator 3 on October 29. Its open world depicts Colorado mountains and Texas grasslands, where players hunt alongside a canine companion.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report explicitly relays Nacon's announcement of that day's release.
entries.timeNote: The 4Gamer article was published at 19:16 on October 29, Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Illustration accompanying this report: Hunting Simulator 3 launches with hunting areas in Colorado and Texas

entries.headline: Weiß Schwarz Online sets March 25, 2027 release date
entries.summary: Bushiroad has announced that digital card game Weiß Schwarz Online will launch on March 25, 2027 for PC, Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch, with preorders open for the physical Switch 2 edition.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report explicitly relays Bushiroad's release-date announcement.
entries.timeNote: The 4Gamer article was published at 16:22 on October 29, Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Illustration accompanying this report: Weiß Schwarz Online sets March 25, 2027 release date

entries.headline: Nomad Drive launches with survival driving for up to four players
entries.summary: Indie Devil launched Nomad Drive on October 29. Players repair a motorhome, gather resources and survive together in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world, with online play for up to four people.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report explicitly relays Indie Devil's announcement of that day's launch.
entries.timeNote: The 4Gamer article was published at 16:10 on October 29, Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Illustration accompanying this report: Nomad Drive launches with survival driving for up to four players

entries.headline: ぎゅわんぶらあ自己中心派 ドランプ帝国をわからせろ！ announces a November 19 release for Nintendo Switch
entries.summary: Success has announced that its Nintendo Switch download game ぎゅわんぶらあ自己中心派 ドランプ帝国をわからせろ！ will release on November 19, with the script written by original creator Masayuki Katayama.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report explicitly relays Success's release-date announcement.
entries.timeNote: The 4Gamer article was published at 13:54 on October 29, Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Illustration accompanying this report: ぎゅわんぶらあ自己中心派 ドランプ帝国をわからせろ！ announces a November 19 release for Nintendo Switch

entries.headline: PegLotto! sets November 11 Steam launch
entries.summary: Ludica has announced that PegLotto!, a roguelike combining slot-machine probabilities and pinball physics, will launch on PC via Steam on November 11. A demo is available now.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays Ludica's release-date announcement.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON article was published at 15:34 on October 29, Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Illustration accompanying this report: PegLotto! sets November 11 Steam launch

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI developers compare its map size to three earlier games combined
entries.summary: AUTOMATON relays Edge's interview with a Rockstar North lead: the team says the Grand Theft Auto VI map is comparable in size to the maps of GTA IV, GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 combined, while also emphasizing the density of interiors and alleyways.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly attributes the information to Edge's independent interview with a Rockstar North lead.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON article was published at 13:03 on October 29, Beijing time.

mediaAlts.alt: Illustration accompanying this report: Grand Theft Auto VI developers compare its map size to three earlier games combined

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI appears in about 20 seconds of footage in the latest South Park episode
entries.summary: The October 29 South Park episode Guinea Pig On A Stick features approximately 20 seconds of Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay footage, with Rockstar Games thanked in the end credits.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report provides checkable details about the episode, clip duration and end-credit acknowledgment. The footage is not treated as an official promise of gameplay features.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON article was published at 09:01 on October 30, Beijing time, before this edition's 10:10 cutoff.

mediaAlts.alt: Illustration accompanying this report: Grand Theft Auto VI appears in about 20 seconds of footage in the latest South Park episode

entries.headline: Attack on Titan 3 producer discusses retelling the full story and its original protagonist
entries.summary: IGN played Attack on Titan 3 and interviewed producer Hideo Suzuki. Rather than a direct sequel, the game retells the original story from beginning to end, with players taking the role of an original Scout character who becomes an instructor following trauma.
entries.verification: IGN's opened hands-on preview and producer interview directly describe the game's structure and original protagonist.
entries.timeNote: The IGN article was published at 09:00 on October 30, Beijing time, before this edition's 10:10 cutoff.

mediaAlts.alt: Illustration accompanying this report: Attack on Titan 3 producer discusses retelling the full story and its original protagonist
